text:
sophia: Heads-up — we should scope a multi-quarter capability partition of the ingest+enrich monolith. I sketched a short playbook and a lightweight contract shim to make incremental cutovers less risky. sharing the core here so we can align quickly.

james: +1. can you paste the playbook summary inline? makes it easier for folks to react.

sophia: TL;DR: 1) identify smallest capability boundary (schema validation + enrichment lookup), 2) extract stateless enrichment workers behind a stable RPC contract, 3) introduce versioned event envelope + shim in the monolith, 4) run canary traffic -> toggle to dedicated workers with fallback, 5) drift detection and paydown sprint for remaining cohesion issues. target timeline: Q3–Q4 for first slice, then iterative every 6–8 weeks.

liam: a couple quick tradeoffs: extraction reduces surface for tech debt but increases operational complexity (deployment + observability). we need deterministic request tracing across the shim boundary.

sophia: agreed. plan includes automatic trace propagation and a per-request trace-id header we enforce at the shim.

rao: main data risk is event schema evolution. if we split, consumers of the enrich output will see subtle shape changes. propose an explicit schema registry + automated compatibility checks during CI.

jana: compatibility checks are a must. also suggest we add a runtime fallback: if the extracted worker returns a non-200 or >200ms latency, the monolith should replay the request to the old code path for N attempts. avoids user-facing regressions during ramp.

liam: fallback + rate-limited replay seems right. we should also track per-tenant error budgets so noisy tenants don't take the whole cluster down.

sophia: good call. include per-tenant throttles & circuit-breaker metrics in the playbook.

arch-bot: Note: RFC-2024-07-arch-23 (service partitioning guidelines) already has a section on versioned contracts — we should align this playbook with that RFC to avoid duplication.

james: here's a tiny contract sketch I put in the thread for discussion:
```
POST /enrich/v1
Request: { "items": [{"id":"string","text":"string"}], "profile": "string" }
Response: { "enriched": [{"id":"string","attributes": {...}}], "meta": {"version":"1"} }
Events: envelope -> {"version":"1","kind":"enrich_result","payload": ... }
```

rao: ok but we need an explicit error taxonomy for enrich failures (transient vs permanent vs partial). that drives replay/warning behavior.

jana: +1. also add a migration plan for DB ownership where the canonical enrichment cache moves. need zero-downtime migration steps (dual-write, backfill, switch reads).

liam: a note on caching: extracted workers will share KV caches across instances. we'll need an eviction policy that stays compatible with the monolith's expectations to avoid correctness bugs. maybe a short-lived prefix for extracted workers during ramp.

sophia: add to playbook: cache prefixing + a TTL migration window. ops: bump cache keys to include service version during canary.

deploy-bot: staging: shim v0.1 deployed to cluster-enrich-staging on commit 1a2b3c, smoke tests passed.

james: nice. can we get a quick experiment: route 5% of production traffic to the extracted worker for a non-critical tenant next week? measure latency, error modes, and tokenization differences.

sophia: yes — propose tenant 'beta-9' for the first canary. I'll own the rollout and monitoring dashboard.

rao: action items: 1) sophia — finalize playbook doc and compatibility checklist (due EOD Wed), 2) liam — draft tracing + circuit-breaker integration (due Fri), 3) jana — DB migration runbook stub (due next Tue), 4) james — define canary tenant and traffic steering plan (due Thu).

sophia: sounds good. one more: we should budget a 2-week tech-debt sprint after the first slice to remediate tangles uncovered during extraction (shared libs, implicit contracts). don't want debt to accumulate between slices.

liam: +1. and let's add an explicit rollback hypothesis per slice — what happens if enriched results diverge in quality metrics. we need a fast switch to monolith plus postmortem template.

sophia: will add rollback and postmortem template. thanks everyone — I'll drop the playbook link and the initial checklist into the RFC channel and schedule a 30m sync for Tuesday. :calendar: :rocket:

arch-bot: Reminder: add RFC cross-links and tag with 'partitioning' + 'tech-debt-paydown' labels.
